name: Mieres (Girona, Spain)
description: Red field with the first vertical third yellow, charged with two keys in saltire counterchanged, red on the yellow and yellow on the red.
history: The council opened the adoption file on 21 May 1998 and the flag was approved on 12 June 1998 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is based on the arms, parted gules and or with two keys in saltire counterchanged: an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with the first vertical third yellow and the keys red on the yellow and yellow on the red.
